subject: Re: MAP draft & POC environment dependencies
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Apr 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & POC environment dependencies

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call today. Attached is the MAP draft we discussed (MAP-draft-v1.pdf) with the POC milestones populated. Core ask here is to confirm owners and feasibility for the POC environment dependencies so we can lock the POC target dates.

Summary (recap of today's DISCOVERY):
- POC objective: Validate Redwood inference in Acme internal VPC with SSO and secrets backed by customer KMS; baseline throughput test and latency SLO verification.
- Proposed POC target close date: 2026-05-07

POC environment milestone: Network & Identity dependencies (actionable items)
1) VPC peering / private connectivity
   - What we need from Acme: Create VPC peering or transit gateway from Acme VPC to Redwood VPC; provide peering connection ID and routing table updates.
   - Acme owner: IT Ops (please confirm)
   - Target completion: 2026-04-20

2) IP allowlists / firewall rules
   - What we need from Redwood: public egress IP ranges for the POC control-plane and data-plane endpoints (we'll provide NAT/test IPs).
   - What we need from Acme: Add Redwood IP ranges to your allowlist for both inbound management and egress to Redwood.
   - Target completion: 2026-04-21

3) SSO / SAML configuration
   - What we need from Acme: SAML 2.0 metadata XML (IdP metadata), single sign-on URL, and test user account.
   - Redwood will provide SP metadata and test instructions.
   - Acme owner: Priya (Engineering IAM)
   - Target completion: 2026-04-16

4) Secrets / KMS integration
   - Option A (preferred for security): Customer-managed KMS key + access policy allowing Redwood service account to unwrap envelope keys.
   - Option B: Redwood-managed key (temporary for POC) if corporate policy requires.
   - Action: Acme security to confirm KMS preference and provide key ARN / access policy details.
   - Target completion: 2026-04-22

Owners / Responsibilities (proposed)
- Acme: Provision peering, update firewall rules, provide SAML metadata, confirm KMS approach.
- Redwood (Nikhil + infra team): Provide IP ranges, SP metadata, step-by-step network runbook, staging test harness, and hands-on SRE support during peering validation.
- Marissa: MAP owner; coordinate timelines, update HubSpot and get approvals.

Next steps / Asks
- Alex: please confirm owners for VPC and KMS and whether Acme prefers Option A or B for KMS by end of day Monday 4/13.
- Priya: please send SAML metadata XML or Okta export; if needed, let's schedule the SAML config call with Nikhil.
- I will schedule a 30-min tech deep-dive with Nikhil the week of 4/13 to walk through network runbook and IP tests.

Attached: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (draft MAP), network_requirements.xlsx (network checklist)

Thanks — Marissa

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and the draft MAP. Quick notes from our side: 
- Confirmed owners: IT Ops will own VPC peering (I'm looping in them on this thread). Priya will own SSO/SAML. Security will take a look at KMS and confirm preference.
- Timeline: we can provision peering by 2026-04-20 as your draft suggests. Priya expects to have SAML metadata ready by 2026-04-15. Security wants to review the KMS integration details before committing (should be able to confirm by 2026-04-16).

Can you send the Redwood egress/IP list and any sample routing table entries? IT Ops also asked for a simple network diagram they can hand to the infra team.

I'll attach a quick network inventory spreadsheet we have for the VPCs (network_requirements.xlsx).

Thanks,
Alex

Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 12:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & POC environment dependencies

Alex / Priya — glad to be on this. Quick technical checklist from Redwood's side before the peering call: 
- Redwood will provide a set of temporary egress IPs for the POC (we'll confirm the list by EOD Fri 4/10). These are NATed IPs for control-plane calls + model pull.
- For VPC peering: we'll need the peering connection ID and a route that sends traffic to the Redwood managed subnet. We can provide sample route table entries and a small CIDR mapping doc.
- For SAML: please share your IdP metadata XML and a test user; we will generate SP metadata and test the assertion flow. If Acme uses Okta, a small SAML test app config usually takes 20-30 minutes.
- For KMS: if Acme wants Customer-managed keys, we need the Key ARN and a policy granting Decrypt/Encrypt to the Redwood service principal; otherwise we can fallback to Redwood-managed encryption for the POC (not ideal but acceptable for short sandbox).

Can we set a 30-min technical deep-dive on Tue 14 Apr at 10:00 AM PT to walk through the runbook? I can share a VPN/peering validation checklist in advance.

Thanks — Nikhil
